title: Steps to Activate the e-fawateercom Pay service

steps.text:
Navigate to the “Pay Bill Tab” Section: 
 - Log in to the mobile application. 
  - From the account dashboard, navigate to the 'Pay bill' section and click on it.
A new tab will appear for EP Service
When the user clicks EP Service, new page displays to activate the service (first time)
User must choose the account and fill the account nickname
Once confirmed by user with OTP the service will be activated
After activating the service, the user will be able to manage the service with options :
Deactivate the service (setting icon beside active)
Edit nick name (3 dots beside nick name)
Change linked account (3 dots beside account)
**if the account is deactivated then next log in to the service the page will be displayed as first time and user must choose the account and fill the nickname
